show: SELECT issues.*, comments.id AS comment_id, comments.body AS comment_body, comments.created_at AS comment_created_at, comments.created_by AS comment_created_by FROM issues LEFT JOIN comments ON comments.issue_id = issues.id WHERE issues.id = :id ORDER BY comments.created_at, comments.id
list: SELECT issues.* FROM issues WHERE (:tool IS NULL OR tool = :tool) AND (:project IS NULL OR project = :project) AND (:status IS NULL OR status = :status) AND (:type IS NULL OR type = :type) AND (:priority IS NULL OR priority = :priority) AND (:label IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues AS tagged, json_each(tagged.labels_json) AS label WHERE tagged.id = issues.id AND label.value = :label)) AND sort_key > :after AND (:query IS NULL OR instr(body, :query) > 0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comments WHERE issue_id = issues.id AND instr(body, :query) > 0)) ORDER BY sort_key LIMIT :limit
